name: executive-dysfunction
description: Evidence-informed, consent-preserving executive-function support for ADHD-related task initiation, planning, time awareness, and completion.

interface.shortDescription: Turn stalled work into one doable next action.
interface.longDescription: Identifies one executive-function bottleneck, externalises the work state, and helps execute a low-friction next action without diagnosis, shame, or unapproved monitoring.
interface.defaultPrompt: Help me move this task forward with low-friction executive-function support.
